summary: This topic covers the generation of fee receipts upon successful payment, including options for customizing the receipt template, displaying collected amounts, fee heads, and any entered remarks.
steps: Complete the fee collection process and save the transaction.
A fee receipt will be automatically generated.
(Admin) To customize, share your desired fee receipt template, including logo, design, and specific columns to be displayed, with the ERP team.
The receipt will display the collected amount, individual fee heads, installments, and any remarks entered during collection.
business_rules: A confirmation is provided before finalizing the fee collection.
The format and content of the fee receipt are customizable to match institutional requirements.
important_notes: The receipt will clearly indicate the payment mode (e.g., 'Cash', 'Online').
The institution's logo can be integrated into the receipt template.
The receipt can be printed or exported for records.
The receipt number and admission number (if applicable) will be automatically populated.
questions: How is a fee receipt generated after a payment?
